body_html: PonsRAG was accepted at EMNLP 2026 (Poster). The preprint was released on August 26; the conference is scheduled for October 24–29 in Budapest.
Represented the WeChat team at SIGIR 2026 in Melbourne (July 20–24), presenting WeSEAL in an Oral session. WeWrite was accepted as a Poster at the same conference. Photos →
Released HeadRank on arXiv on April 19. The paper is under submission to ICLR 2027.
Presented ComoRAG as a Poster at AAAI 2026 in Singapore (January 20–27). Photos →
Joined Tencent WXG — Search Application Department as an LLM Algorithm Intern.
ComoRAG was accepted at AAAI 2026 (Poster); the November arXiv revision records the acceptance.
MVISU-Bench and HEAR appeared at ACM Multimedia 2025 (October 27–31, Dublin), both as Oral papers. MVISU-Bench project →
Joined Weavin.ai as a RAG Application Development Intern (September–November 2025).
Released ComoRAG on arXiv on August 14; the code is publicly available.
Joined Tencent WXG — Pattern Recognition Center (WeChat AI) through industry-university cooperation (February–August 2025).
Started my M.Sc. at South China University of Technology and joined China Southern Power Grid — CSG Smart Technology as an Algorithm Intern (September–December 2024).
Co-authored TL-DREN: Transfer Learning Based Detection and Recognition of Electricity Nameplates (ICIHCS 2024).
